_readme: GO LIVE: this is the ONLY file you need to edit to start earning.
1. Replace every 'url' value beginning with PLACEHOLDER_ with the real
tracking link from your affiliate network.
3. Run:  python3 tools/check.py   -- it will refuse to pass while any
PLACEHOLDER_ string remains, so you cannot accidentally ship dead links.
Until then the build renders a plain outbound link to the provider's own
site instead of an affiliate link, so the site is fully browsable and no
commission is claimed on any click.
Commission figures below are what the providers publicly advertise. They
are informational only and are never used in scoring. If a rate changes,
update it here so the disclosure page stays accurate.

disclosureBar.en: This page contains affiliate links. If you buy through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It does not affect our ranking — see how we rank.
disclosureBar.sv: Denna sida innehåller annonslänkar. Om du köper via dem kan vi få en provision utan att det kostar dig något. Det påverkar inte vår rankning — se så rankar vi.

termsNote.en: Prohibits paid search bidding on brand terms. Requires disclosure of affiliate status.
